items.rule: Do not map the UI value to encoder bits per second until traced.
Metadata declarations are not complete on-wire schemas.
Do not emit success-state events without a real backend transition.
Trace the client proactive send and recorder pull behavior independently.
Do not fabricate hardware identity, tokens, or entitlements.
Preserve the sole export and avoid blind retries until duplicate behavior is traced.
Full sessions remain unverified until the original client transition order is recovered.
Do not infer editor-compatible track order from MP4 muxing alone.
A declared toggleBroadcast method does not establish a backend or endpoint.
Windows injection/plugin assets are not portable implementations.
